newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST - China's M2 seen up 23 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - China's M2 seen up 23 pct in 1997.

text.p: China's broad M2 money supply will expand about 23 percent this year, China Securities said on Tuesday.

The newspaper quoted the State Information Centre under the State Planning Commission as saying M1, currency in circulation plus current business deposits, will grow a year-on-year 18.0 percent in 1997.
M0, currency in circulation, will rise a year-on-year 13.6 percent in 1997, it said.
A central bank forecast made in May also put M2 growth at 23 percent this year.
M2 grew 25.3 percent in 1996 while M1 rose 18.9 percent and M0 expanded by 11.6 percent, official figures showed.
